cues: Where does a reaction's energy come from?
Every reaction breaks bonds and makes new ones.
Breaking a bond always costs energy.
For hydrogen and chlorine, breaking one H H bond and one Cl Cl bond costs four thirty six plus two forty two, six hundred and seventy eight kilojoules.
